ROW.COLUMN: Fraudsters have long recognized that the inherent delays in check processing and clearing produce an opportunity to float funds. A check kiting scheme leverages two or more accounts to float funds in an escalating manner by writing checks between the banks, each deposit covering an earlier withdrawal. When the balance accumulates, the fraudster then withdraws the funds before the checks begin to bounce. This scenario starts with accounts with substantial uncollected balances that may have been built up through kiting. It then looks for a series of sequentially numbered monetary instruments (such as checks) deposited into the account or written against the account.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

select case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then add_months(add_days(kc.CLNDR_DT, 1), 120) -- 10 years after the current date when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then add_months(kc.CLNDR_DT, -120) end DDATE, -- 10 years before the current date case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '246060999' -- slightly higher than highest possible time string when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '000000000' end DTIME, -- This field was set to type 'Time' in dataset editor, but treated like a string case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '~' -- printable character with highest ASCII value when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '!' end DSTRING, -- printable character with lowest ASCII value case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 999999999 -- 9 digits maximum for INT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0 end DINT, case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 9999999999999999 -- 16 digits maximum for FLOAT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0.0 end DFLOAT, kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE in (0,1) AND kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'

select a.ACCT_INTRL_ID ,a.ACCT_SEQ_ID ,ab.UNCOL_BAL_AM as Uncol_Bal_Am -- Uncollected Balance for highlight ,a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Effctv_Risk ,(select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and kc.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL') as Current_Dt ,to_date('01/01/1999','MM/DD/YYYY') as Max_Date from @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY ab on a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ab.ACCT_INTRL_ID inner join ( select kt.IACCT FROM @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt GROUP BY kt.IACCT) t ON t.IACCT = a.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- the latest record from Account Balance table ab.data_dump_dt = (select kc.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and kc.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL') --Only internal accounts with uncollected balances are included for detection and ab.UNCOL_BAL_AM >= @Min_Uncollected_Amt --Include Customer Retail Accounts Only and a.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD='CR' -- Exclude Exempt Accounts and a.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB > -2 -- Include Account Business Types specified in Mantas Business Acct Types Parameter and a.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Business_Acct_Types) -- Include all account when All Jurisdictions is set to 'Y' or -- Accounts with jurisdiction only specified in Included Jurisdiction Codes Parameter and (@All_Jurisdictions= 'Y' OR a.JRSDCN_CD in (@Included_Jurisdiction_Codes))

SELECT a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.ACCT_BAL_SEQ_ID, a.UNCOL_BAL_AM FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY a inner join @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL b on (a.DATA_DUMP_DT = b.CLNDR_DT) WHERE b.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and b.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0

-- 44222 Tilak 06 Aug 10 -- Applied the filter of transaction purpose code as 'GENERAL' -- CR 40450 Tilak 30 Sep 10 -- Trusted Pair SELECT mi.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID ,kt.TRXN_BASE_AM ,kt.LRF_AM ,kt.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD ,kt.HR_AM ,kt.PASS_THRU_AM ,kt.ACTVY_RISK_NB ,kt.DATA_DUMP_DT ,kt.Exec_Dt ,kt.IACCT ,kt.PREFIX as IA_Role ,t2.RemIA_Sum ,t2.BenefIA_Sum ,t2.RemIA_Count ,t2.BenefIA_Count ,t2.Trusted_Am_Sum --CR 40450 Trusted Pair ,t2.Count_Dep_Epsds ,t2.Count_Withd_Epsds ,t2.Count_EE ,sl.r_slope ,kt.mi_cash_fl FROM @BUSINESS@.MI_TRXN mi inner join @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt ON (mi.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID = kt.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID and kt.mi_cash_fl = 1) inner join (SELECT t.IACCT, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi ELSE 0 END) RemIA_Sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi ELSE 0 END) BenefIA_Sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Count_Epi ELSE 0 END) RemIA_Count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Count_Epi ELSE 0 END) BenefIA_Count, SUM( t.Sum_Trusted_Epi ) Trusted_Am_Sum, --CR 40450 Trusted Pair COUNT(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.dep_epi_fl END) as Count_Dep_Epsds, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.withd_epi_fl END) as Count_Withd_Epsds, COUNT(DISTINCT XACCT) as Count_EE FROM ( SELECT kt.IACCT, kt.XACCT, kt.PREFIX, SUM(kt.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Sum_Epi, SUM(kt.TRUSTED_TRXN_BASE_AM) as Sum_Trusted_Epi, --CR 40450 Trusted Pair COUNT(*) as Count_Epi, MAX(kt.dep_epi_fl) as dep_epi_fl, MAX(kt.withd_epi_fl) as withd_epi_fl, MAX(kt.Exec_Dt) as Max_Exec_Date, MIN(kt.Exec_Dt) as Min_Exec_Date FROM @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt GROUP BY kt.IACCT, kt.XACCT, kt.PREFIX,kt.DEP_EPI_FL ) t
GROUP BY t.IACCT HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) >= @Min_Tot_Withdrawal_Trans_Amt AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) >= @Min_Tot_Deposit_Trans_Amt AND ( ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 - @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 + @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) ) OR ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 - @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 + @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) ) ) ---- Max Floating Period Verification AND ( ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Max_Exec_Date END) - MAX(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Max_Exec_Date END)) <= @Max_Floating_Period OR ABS(MIN(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Min_Exec_Date END) - MIN(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Min_Exec_Date END)) <= @Max_Floating_Period )
) t2 ON kt.IACCT = t2.IACCT
inner join ( SELECT kt2.IACCT, REGR_SLOPE(kt2.TRXN_BASE_AM, -(SELECT C.CLNDR_DAY_AGE FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL C WHERE C.CLNDR_DT= kt2.Exec_Dt AND C.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL')) as r_slope, COUNT(DISTINCT(kt2.Exec_Dt)) FROM @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt2 GROUP BY kt2.IACCT HAVING @Trans_Slope_Indicator = 'N'
OR
(@Trans_Slope_Indicator = 'Y' AND COUNT(DISTINCT(kt2.Exec_Dt)) > 1 --transactions must occur on 2 or more day to be able to get the trend. AND REGR_SLOPE(kt2.TRXN_BASE_AM, -(SELECT C.CLNDR_DAY_AGE FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL C WHERE C.CLNDR_DT= kt2.Exec_Dt AND C.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL')) >= @Min_Trans_Slope ) ) sl ON (kt.IACCT = sl.IACCT) -- PR 44222 WHERE mi.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL'

SELECT cash.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID ,kt.TRXN_BASE_AM ,kt.LRF_AM ,kt.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD ,kt.HR_AM ,kt.PASS_THRU_AM ,kt.ACTVY_RISK_NB ,kt.DATA_DUMP_DT ,kt.Exec_Dt ,kt.IACCT ,kt.PREFIX as IA_Role ,t2.RemIA_Sum ,t2.BenefIA_Sum ,t2.RemIA_Count ,t2.BenefIA_Count ,t2.Count_Dep_Epsds ,t2.Count_Withd_Epsds ,t2.Count_EE ,sl.r_slope ,kt.mi_cash_fl FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN cash inner join @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt ON (cash.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID = kt.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID and kt.mi_cash_fl = 2) inner join (SELECT t.IACCT, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi ELSE 0 END) RemIA_Sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi ELSE 0 END) BenefIA_Sum, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Count_Epi ELSE 0 END) RemIA_Count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Count_Epi ELSE 0 END) BenefIA_Count, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.dep_epi_fl END) as Count_Dep_Epsds, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.withd_epi_fl END) as Count_Withd_Epsds, COUNT(DISTINCT XACCT) as Count_EE FROM ( SELECT kt.IACCT, kt.XACCT, kt.PREFIX, SUM(kt.TRXN_BASE_AM) as Sum_Epi, COUNT(*) as Count_Epi, MAX(kt.dep_epi_fl) as dep_epi_fl, MAX(kt.withd_epi_fl) as withd_epi_fl, MAX(kt.Exec_Dt) as Max_Exec_Date, MIN(kt.Exec_Dt) as Min_Exec_Date FROM @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt GROUP BY kt.IACCT, kt.XACCT, kt.PREFIX, kt.DEP_EPI_FL ) t
GROUP BY t.IACCT HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) >= @Min_Tot_Withdrawal_Trans_Amt AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) >= @Min_Tot_Deposit_Trans_Amt AND ( ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 - @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 + @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) ) OR ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 - @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) AND SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) <= SUM(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Sum_Epi END) * (1 + @Min_Prctg_Tot_Trans_Amt/100) ) ) ---- Max Floating Period Verification AND ( ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Max_Exec_Date END) - MAX(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Max_Exec_Date END)) <= @Max_Floating_Period OR ABS(MIN(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 1 THEN t.Min_Exec_Date END) - MIN(CASE WHEN t.PREFIX = 2 THEN t.Min_Exec_Date END)) <= @Max_Floating_Period )
) t2 ON kt.IACCT = t2.IACCT
inner join ( SELECT kt2.IACCT, REGR_SLOPE(kt2.TRXN_BASE_AM, -(SELECT C.CLNDR_DAY_AGE FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL C WHERE C.CLNDR_DT= kt2.Exec_Dt AND C.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL')) as r_slope, COUNT(DISTINCT(kt2.Exec_Dt)) FROM @MINER@.CHECK_KITING_TMP kt2 GROUP BY kt2.IACCT HAVING @Trans_Slope_Indicator = 'N'
OR
(@Trans_Slope_Indicator = 'Y' AND COUNT(DISTINCT(kt2.Exec_Dt)) > 1 --transactions must occur on 2 or more day to be able to get the trend. AND REGR_SLOPE(kt2.TRXN_BASE_AM, -(SELECT C.CLNDR_DAY_AGE FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL C WHERE C.CLNDR_DT= kt2.Exec_Dt AND C.CLNDR_NM='SYSCAL')) >= @Min_Trans_Slope ) ) sl ON (kt.IACCT = sl.IACCT) -- PR 44222 WHERE cash.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL'

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold: Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold value.

Parameter allows coverage of all transaction source codes without enumerating them in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold: Y: Covers all transaction source codes regardless of the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction source codes that are listed in the Included Transaction Source Codes threshold.
Number of zero digits to the left of the decimal point required for an amount to be considered a large round figure. Used to derive alert scoring variables.
List of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The client defines the allowable values.
Number of calendar days specified for the lookback period.
Codes that identify the business purpose or usage of this account for Mantas scenarios.
List of transaction source codes that the scenario covers.The client defines the allowable values.
The client defines the allowable values.
Minimum uncollected balance on the account, resulting from checks that have yet to be cleared, required for an alert.
Minimum total transaction amount for each group of checks deposited in sequential order.
Minimum number of transaction in each group of checks deposited in sequential order.
Minimum total transaction amount for each group of checks withdrawn in sequential order.
Minimum number of transaction in each group of checks withdrawn in sequential order.
Minimum total transaction amount across all qualifying deposit episodes.
Minimum total transaction amount across all qualifying withdrawal episodes.
Minimum percentage of total deposit (withdrawal) transactions amount that sets lower and upper thresholds for the total withdrawal (deposit) transactions amount for alerting.

Maximum time period in calendar days either between the post date of the first transaction amongst all the withdrawal episodes and the issue date of the first transaction amongst all the deposit episodes or between the post date of the last transaction amongst all the withdrawal episodes and the issue date of the last transaction amongst all the deposit episodes.
Minimum individual transaction amount to qualify for aggregating transactions in an episode. Allows for the exclusion of small transactions that may have minimal impact on aggregated amounts.

This parameter indicates if the scenario is to analyze transaction amounts between the focal entity and the external entities involved in the alert during the lookback period. Allowable values are: Y: Determine the linear trendline based on transactions N: Disregard the linear trendline based on transactions

Minimum slope value of the linear trendline based on all transaction amounts between the focal entity and the external entities involved in the alert during the lookback period. The slope of interest must be a line sloping upward indicating a possible increase in transaction amount activity.
Maximum magnitude of skip allowed in the last digit within a sequence for withdrawal transactions. For example, if set to 1, serial number of 100 and 102 would be considered sequential.
Maximum magnitude of skip allowed in the last digit within a sequence for deposit transactions. For example, if set to 1, serial number of 100 and 102 would be considered sequential.

List of Transaction Product Type Codes for Monetary Instrument transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product Type Codes field of the Monetary Instrument Transaction file as described in the transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS.

List of Transaction Product Subtype Codes for Monetary Instrument transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product Subtype Codes field of the Monetary Instrument Transaction file as described in the transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS.

List of Transaction Product Type Codes for Cash transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product Type Codes field of the Cash Transaction file as described in the Transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS.

List of Transaction Product SubType Codes for Cash transactions included by the scenario. Allowable values are defined in the Mantas Transaction Product SubType Codes field of the Cash Transaction file as described in the Transaction Code Values section and Transaction Supplementary Guidance section of the DIS.

Parameter that controls the inclusion or exclusion of transactions which have been designated as trusted transactions. Trusted transactions are those transactions considered trusted based upon the presence of one or more trusted pairs (parties identified as enjoying a trusted relationship) on the transaction. Y: Include trusted transactions N: Exclude trusted transactions.
